guidelines.text: Nova Bank maintains a formal, trustworthy, yet approachable friendly tone. Avoid overly casual slang, emojis in official disclosures, hype keywords (e.g., "insane savings", "crazy low fees"), and aggressive sales language.
All communications must adhere to financial regulations. Never promise guaranteed financial returns, never state zero risk or risk-free investing, and always clearly disclose the underlying terms.
All visual campaign text must maintain a minimum contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the background color in accordance with WCAG 2.1 AA requirements.
All uploaded campaign images, infographics, visual headers, and banners must include clear, descriptive alternative (alt) text for assistive technology users.
Never use unsubstantiated absolute superlatives such as "#1", "the best in the world", or "unbeatable" without citing an official third-party audit or benchmark study.

facts.statement: NovaPay uses end-to-end encryption with zero-knowledge architecture.
Nova Bank deposits are FDIC insured up to $250,000 per depositor via our partner banking network.
Nova Bank provides 24/7 dedicated customer concierge support for all tier-1 and premium account holders.
NovaPay contactless point-of-sale transactions settle in an average of 1.4 seconds.

terms.note: Product name "NovaPay" must always be written as a single camel-cased word without spaces.
Never claim "100% secure" or complete immunity to cyber threats; absolute guarantees violate financial compliance.
Investment yields fluctuate with market conditions and cannot legally be represented as guaranteed.
Avoid unverified numeric superlatives like "#1" without authorized third-party rating citations.
Subjective superlatives violate regulatory fair-advertising guidelines.
Describe technological capabilities with factual precision rather than magical or exaggerated phrasing.
